# apple_app_clip_header_image (Resource)

Uploads the image on the App Clip card of a default App Clip experience, for one localization. A localization has one header image; uploading another replaces it. A changed file is uploaded as a new one, which replaces the resource. Destroying the resource deletes the file. Import it by ID; the next apply then uploads the configured file.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_clip_header_image" "en_US" {
  localization_id = apple_app_clip_default_experience_localization.en_US.id
  file            = "${path.module}/app-clip-card.png"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file` (String) Path of the file to upload. Relative paths are relative to where Terraform runs, so use `"${path.module}/..."`.
- `localization_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization, e.g. `apple_app_clip_default_experience_localization.en_US.id`.

### Read-Only

- `checksum` (String) MD5 checksum of the file.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Clip header image.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_clip_header_image.en_US
  identity = {
    id = "9b1d3f5a-7c2e-4d6b-a8f0-3e4a5b6c7d8e"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Clip header image.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_clip_header_image.en_US 9b1d3f5a-7c2e-4d6b-a8f0-3e4a5b6c7d8e
```
